subject: Anna Callahan State Representative Endorsement
overview: Daphne Bowen spoke at a campaign launch party for Anna Callahan, describing the local paraprofessional contract fight and endorsing Callahan's candidacy for State Representative.

items.title: Introduction of Daphne Bowen
items.summary: An organizer introduced Daphne Bowen as a local educator and leader in the paraprofessional contract fight.

items.title: Remarks on Paraprofessional Contract Fight and Campaign Endorsement
items.summary: Daphne Bowen outlined the low pay and contract struggles faced by paraprofessionals and endorsed Anna Callahan for State Representative.
